title: Commercial Roofing in McAllen, TX | Edel Roofing & Construction
description: Commercial flat roof repair, replacement and coatings in McAllen, TX. TPO, EPDM, modified bitumen, work planned around your tenants. Call (956) 422-3335.
lede: Edel Roofing & Construction repairs, replaces, and coats flat and low slope roofs on McAllen retail, office, medical, and warehouse buildings. We're licensed, bonded and insured, and the written estimate is free.

sections.title: Flat roofs in the Valley's retail center
paras: McAllen is where the Rio Grande Valley shops. The city reported $99.9 million in sales tax revenue in 2025, the most of any city in the RGV. That business happens under flat roofs. La Plaza Mall on S 10th St covers about 1.32 million square feet, and the strip centers, restaurants, clinics, and warehouses around it add a lot more. McAllen Medical Center sits on W Expressway 83, with medical offices spread across the city.

On a building like that, a leak is an operations problem. Tenants lose sales, inventory gets wet, and patients and staff still have to come in. So every McAllen commercial job starts the same way. We inspect the whole roof, then give you a written scope: what we'll do, what it costs, and when we can do it around your hours.
Our office is at 1815 N Jackson Rd in Edinburg, about 11 minutes from McAllen City Hall. We've worked on commercial roofs across Hidalgo County since 2003.

sections.title: Commercial roofing services for McAllen buildings

cards.title: Flat roof installation
cards.body: New TPO, EPDM, or modified bitumen roof systems, the membranes most used on commercial buildings in South Texas.

cards.title: Commercial roof replacement
cards.body: We tear off the worn out roof, check the decking for water damage, and install a new membrane on a timeline you get in writing.

cards.title: Leak and membrane repair
cards.body: We repair the seam, puncture, flashing or drain where the leak really starts. On a flat roof that can be far from the drip inside.

cards.title: Roof coatings
cards.body: Reflective coatings over a sound but aging membrane. See roof coatings in McAllen for when that makes sense.

cards.title: Storm and hail damage
cards.body: Punctures, torn edges and loose flashing after a storm. We write it all up for your insurance company.

cards.title: Inspections and maintenance
cards.body: Scheduled inspections for owners and property managers, with a written report of what needs work now and what can wait.

sections.title: How McAllen weather wears out a commercial roof
paras: A flat roof takes the full sun all day. NOAA normals for the McAllen airport show 177 days a year at 90°F or hotter and an August average high of 99.6°F. Heat and UV dry out membranes, open seams, and crack the sealant at curbs and penetrations. A dark roof surface in that sun gets far hotter than the air.

Wind is the other problem. On April 28, 2023, a 74 mph gust was measured in McAllen, and the NWS damage survey found a building on S 29th St with more than half of its shingles gone. On May 8, 2025, a microburst estimated at 80 to 85 mph hit the area between Taylor Rd and Ware Rd, and spotters reported 2 inch hail in north McAllen. On a flat roof, wind gets under the membrane at the edges and at loose flashing, and hail punctures soft spots.
Then there's the rain. September is the wettest month at the airport, about 4.6 inches on average. Clogged drains and scuppers let water pond, and ponding water finds every open seam.

sections.title: What a McAllen commercial job looks like

cards.title: 1. Walk the roof
cards.body: We inspect the full roof, drains, edges, curbs, and rooftop units, and take photos.

cards.title: 2. Written scope
cards.body: Repair, coating, or replacement, with the price and the schedule in writing. If a repair will do it, the scope says repair.

cards.title: 3. Plan around your hours
cards.body: We work around tenant schedules and business hours so the store or clinic can stay open.

cards.title: 4. Records for your files
cards.body: You get documentation for your insurance and maintenance records when the job is done.

faqs.q: Our store has a leak and we can't close. Can you work around that?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us your hours and your busiest days. We plan the work around them and around your tenants.

faqs.q: Which flat roof system is best for a McAllen building?
faqs.a: It depends on the building, the roof area, the deck, and your budget. TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen are all common in South Texas. We explain the trade offs for your roof in the written scope.

faqs.q: How long should a commercial roof last here?
faqs.a: A membrane that's installed well usually lasts 15 to 25 years in the RGV, depending on the material and how well it's kept up. Heat shortens that. Regular inspections help you get to the long end.

faqs.q: We manage several McAllen properties. Can you handle all of them?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with owners and property managers who have more than one building. We can put each property on a regular inspection schedule so problems get caught early.

faqs.q: What causes most flat roof leaks?
faqs.a: Open seams, worn flashing at walls and rooftop curbs, and clogged drains cause most of them. Punctures from hail or foot traffic come next. The drip inside is often far from the source, because water runs along the deck before it comes through the ceiling.

faqs.q: Do you document storm damage on commercial roofs?
faqs.a: Yes. We inspect after a storm and give you a written report with photos for your insurer. We are not a public adjuster, so the claim itself is between you and your insurance company.

faqs.q: How do I get a commercial estimate in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We walk the roof, measure it and give you a written estimate. There's no charge for commercial estimates.
